Commercial Hindi newspaper (Rajasthan Patrika group), general news (politics/crime/local city news). robots.txt explicitly ALLOWS ClaudeBot and anthropic-ai (checked 2026-08-17) - unlike bhaskar.com and amarujala.com, which explicitly Disallow anthropic-ai/ClaudeBot/Claude-Web in their robots.txt and were ruled out on that basis, not attempted here. Configured to use monthly-sitemap.xml directly rather than the top-level sitemap.xml: patrika.com's top-level index nests its daily article sitemaps inside <url><loc> tags instead of standard-conforming <sitemap><loc> tags, which this crawler's recursive sitemap-index detection does not follow (would be mistaken for terminal article pages and fetched as such, yielding garbage). The monthly-sitemap.xml chain (index -> month sitemap -> real <url><loc> article entries) is standards-conformant and resolves within 2 levels of recursion. No explicit reuse licence observed beyond robots.txt; assume all rights reserved. Collected for coursework research use per course policy - not for redistribution.
notes_only_months_available: Six month-level sitemaps found live at check time (Feb-Jul); July alone had ~4,671 article URLs. Real content volume, not exhausted like the smaller manual sources.
